In differential geometry, an '''isoparametric function''' is a function on a [[Riemannian manifold]] whose level surfaces are parallel and of constant mean curvatures. They were introduced by {{harvs|txt|Authorlink=Elie Cartan|last=Cartan|year=1938}}.
